1. PREPARING TO STUDY IN DRESDEN
Visa / Arrival
If you are required to apply for a student visa, it is important that you apply before the

Accommodation

as you receive your acceptance letter at 🔗🔗 studentenwerk-dresden.de
Information about finding a flat or a room in a shared flat is available under:
🔗🔗 tud.de/studium/rund-ums-studium/wohnen

2. APPLICATION PROCEDURES
The TU Dresden is a member of „uni-assist e.V.“, the service organization for
international university applications, a joint effort of numerous German institutions of
higher education. The member institutions have commissioned
uni-assist to accept and evaluate application documents from applicants who have
graduated from foreign secondary schools or institutions of higher education.
However, an application to TU Dresden will not be processed by uni-assist in every
case. Please note the following information:
APPLICATION PROCEDURE THROUGH UNI-ASSIST
 Applicants with a foreign secondary school graduation certificate
• for degree programs taught in German
except EU-applicants for Medicine, Human medicine or Dentistry
• preparatory programs
Propädeutikum or Studienkolleg
 Applicants with a foreign university degree
• for Master´s programs taught in German
• for Master´s programs taught in English (except Tropical Forestry)
• preparatory programs
Propädeutikum
Please apply via uni-assist:
🔗🔗 uni-assist.de/en/how-to-apply
Since this is an online application procedure, no documents need to be sent by post.
You upload all required documents in the uni-assist portal. You can upload either the
scans of the officially certified copies or scans of the original certificates. The
International Office reserves the right to request officially certified copies for the
actual enrollment.
A processing fee of 75 Euro for the first application is required by uni-assist. For each
additional application 30 Euro will be charged. Please note that your application will
only be processed once uni-assist has received your payment. After your documents
have been checked and your eligibility to study at TU Dresden has been verified (4-5
weeks), your data will be sent to the TU Dresden. You will then receive the decision
(admission or rejection) within 4 weeks, or after the numerus clausus selection (middle
of August) or aptitude assessment procedure (dependent on the program).
Before sending your application, please make sure that your documents are
complete since it may not be possible to submit documents later on. You are
advised to submit your application at least one month before the application
deadline.
Seite 2/4
APPLICATION PROCEDURE NOT THROUGH UNI-ASSIST
 The following applicants have to apply directly at the TU Dresden Online
Portal 🔗🔗 selma.tu-dresden.de
1. Applicants with a German Abitur (Bildungsinländer) for undergraduate
programs
2. TU Dresden students (change of major program, TU Dresden graduates) and
graduates from other German institutions. (Exchange students who want to
change to the regular study program have to apply via uni-assist!)
3. Repeat applicants (applicants who have already received a letter of admission
of the TU Dresden, not older than 1 year of the date of issuance)
4. Applicants for the English Master´s program Tropical Forestry
5. Applicants for exchange studies at the TU Dresden
 EU-applicants and applicants with a German Abitur for Medicine, Human
medicine and dentistry apply at 🔗🔗 hochschulstart.de
(non-EU applicants apply through uni-assist)
3.APPLICATION DOCUMENTS
 Application form
 Resume/CV in tabular form + copy/scan of passport or ID
 Photocopies or scans of the original of these documents and of the official
translations (German or English):
o secondary school graduation certificate, if applicable university entrance
exams
o if you have already studied, transcripts of each semester and university
degree (if you already have one)
o current proof of German proficiency (does not apply for English-language
degree program)
 If necessary, other documents required by your desired program (e.g. special
language skills, application for aptitude assessment)
 Certificate of recognition and module description for applications for a higher
semester
 Applicants with Chinese, Vietnamese or Indian educational certificates:
Copy or scan of the original of your APS certificate
Please find detailed information about required documents and application deadlines
at: 🔗🔗 tud.de/online-bewerbung/bewerbungsverfahren-ueber-uni-assist
